descriptionChirho: Armed conflict between opposing forces; a state of hostility or organized military engagement. Covers both singular ('a war') and plural ('wars') forms in all grammatical cases. Used of literal warfare (Mt 24:6; Mk 13:7; Lk 14:31; 21:9; Heb 11:34; Rev 9:7,9; 11:7; 12:7,17; 13:7; 16:14; 19:19; 20:8) and metaphorical inner conflict (Jas 4:1). Translations are uniform across number: eng 'war/wars,' spa 'guerra/guerras,' arb حَرْبٍ/حُرُوبٍ (harb/hurub, warfare), hin युद्ध/युद्धों (yuddh, armed conflict), kor 전쟁/전쟁들 (jeonjaeng, war), swa 'vita' (war, used for both singular and plural in Swahili).
